1.title: Misleading Calm
1.tagline:
Eerie anticipation. Soft fractures.
The world feels wrong but safe.

events.name: Kit Tries to Ground Yuul
events.description: Kit pulls Yuul aside, trying to steady her with humor or ritual. Yuul responds with slight delay.

events.name: Someone Notices
events.description: A stranger studies them too closely: 'You look hollow.'

events.name: Rielle's Impulse
events.description: Rielle acts on sudden instinct. It half-works.

events.name: Grace Moment
events.description: A beautiful moment-a laugh, shared silence, sunrise.

events.name: Bonfire Night
events.description: Their last truly safe moment around a fire.

events.name: The Thing They've Been Avoiding
events.description: A topic resurfaces, met with silence rather than conflict.

events.name: Mission Goes Wrong (Low-Stakes)
events.description: A simple hunt gets sloppy. No one hurt, but coordination falters.

events.name: Rielle Questions Maeve's Choice (Early)
events.description: A soft rebuke, teasing but edged.

events.name: Maeve Reaches Out to Yuul (Early)
events.description: Maeve tries connecting; Yuul deflects.

events.name: Yuul Speaks in Reversals (Soft)
events.description: Yuul says something backward-feeling.

events.name: Yuul Has a Vision - Horror (Tremor)
events.description: An eerie micro-vision she shrugs off.

events.name: Trine Ritual Required (Stabilizing)
events.description: A small ritual stabilizes Yuul, for now.

events.name: Soft Surveillance
events.description: A car, a shadow-maybe following them.

events.name: Misaligned Questions
events.description: DCE asks something slightly off.

events.name: Quiet Heroics
events.description: A mundane save, barely noticed.

events.name: Internal Suspicion (H11)
events.description: A superior asks comforting questions that feel rehearsed.

events.name: The Case That Solves Itself
events.description: A missing person returns with no explanation.

events.name: A Quiet Town Watches
events.description: Locals smile too warmly; eyes linger.

events.name: Yuul Forgets the Date
events.description: A harmless lapse, shrugged off.

events.name: The Map Won't Stay Still
events.description: Printed directions shift. Only Maeve sees it.

events.name: Farris Sees the Shadow First
events.description: Farris stares at a corner no one else feels drawn to. 'It's already watching.'

events.name: Farris Reaches for Maeve
events.description: Farris quietly sits beside Maeve. No words. Just presence.

events.name: Daniel Asks the Wrong Questions
events.description: Daniel tries to help with protocol and paperwork. Maeve feels more distant.

events.name: Daniel Notices Yuul
events.description: Daniel watches Yuul closely. Something in his expression shifts.

2.title: Escalation
2.tagline:
Pressure tightens. Prophecy sharpens.
Institutions falter.

events.name: Kit Overextends Himself
events.description: Kit pushes too far on a case. He hides the exhaustion poorly.

events.name: Maeve's Voice Slips
events.description: Maeve says something she shouldn't know. Rielle notices.

events.name: Rielle Shows a Fracture
events.description: A moment of sharpness breaks through her jokes.

events.name: Trine Ritual (Strained)
events.description: The ritual takes more from them than it gives back.

events.name: H11 Quiet Betrayal
events.description: A report is filed without warning.

events.name: Case Shifts Under Them
events.description: Evidence contradicts itself.

events.name: Maeve Has a Memory Glitch
events.description: She forgets a step, a face, a timeline.

events.name: Yuul Warns About Redchurch
events.description: She speaks a location like a confession.

events.name: Mission Goes Wrong (High Stakes)
events.description: Blood, panic, consequences. A miss, not a disaster.

events.name: Trine Mistrust
events.description: Someone hesitates at the wrong moment.

events.name: Ritual Backfires
events.description: Light bends wrong. Someone gets hurt.

events.name: DCE Checks In (Harder)
events.description: Questions that imply suspicion.

events.name: H11 Pressure Mounts
events.description: Deadlines grow sharp.

events.name: The Town Turns Hostile
events.description: Eyes narrow. Hospitality reverses.

events.name: Maeve's Intuition Spikes
events.description: She senses danger before it arrives.

events.name: Reality Drift
events.description: The ground beneath their choices bends.

events.name: Kit's Soft Breakdown
events.description: He cries without realizing he started.

events.name: Yuul Speaks with Static in Her Voice
events.description: For a moment she sounds like two people.

events.name: Rielle Vanishes Briefly
events.description: She loses time. Comes back grinning.

events.name: Another Memory Gap
events.description: A collective lapse. No one can recall the last five minutes.

events.name: Coherence Failure
events.description: The field shudders. Something fundamental slips.

events.name: Yuul's Last Prophecy
events.description: Yuul's voice thins and deepens all at once. The words are warning, memory, and farewell.

events.name: Prophetic Isolation
events.description: Yuul retreats inward after a frightening surge of prophecy. She pushes others away.

events.name: The Mirror Incident
events.description: A mirror cracks in a way that should not be possible. Reality folds at the edges.

events.name: DCE Investigation
events.description: Agents arrive with questions phrased too perfectly. They already know something.

events.name: DCE Tightens the Net
events.description: Paperwork discrepancies, shadowing teams, and subtle tests appear everywhere.

events.name: DCE Raid on a Safehouse
events.description: One of their fallback locations is compromised. Someone was there recently.

events.name: Horizon 11 Under Review
events.description: H11 leadership receives quiet inquiries. Someone internal is asking the wrong questions.

events.name: Orders from Above
events.description: A directive arrives. It feels rehearsed, like someone else wrote it.

events.name: Farris Intercepts the Stress
events.description: Farris steps in when Maeve's about to snap. 'Not yet. Not here.'

events.name: Farris Smells the Wrongness
events.description: Farris stops mid-sentence, nostrils flaring. 'It's here. Close.'

events.name: Farris Breaks the Tension
events.description: Farris does something absurd at exactly the right moment. Everyone exhales.

events.name: Daniel Covers for Maeve
events.description: Daniel lies to H11 to protect Maeve. It costs him.

events.name: Daniel Detects the Pattern
events.description: Daniel sees the data. The disappearances aren't random. His hands shake.

events.name: Brief Reprieve
events.description: A hunt ends cleanly. A call ends early. No one screams, dissolves, or bleeds. A breath of quiet in the storm.

events.name: Unexpected Kindness
events.description: A stranger they once helped returns the kindness. A reminder that not everything hunts them.

events.name: The House Remembers Them
events.description: The wards glow steady for the first time in months. The Sanctuary feels like home again.

events.name: The Field Bows to Her
events.description: Maeve makes a call only she can see. The world reacts. For a moment her brilliance stabilizes everyone.

events.name: He Refuses to Give Up
events.description: Kit anchors Yuul with desperate tenderness. He becomes the spine of the household.

events.name: She Tells the Truth No One Wants to Hear
events.description: Rielle corners someone and speaks a truth that breaks the spiral. Someone finally listens.

events.name: He Fixes Something, Quietly
events.description: Daniel pulls strings behind the scenes—reroutes a case, deletes a file. Buys them time.

events.name: He Stands Between Them and the Dark
events.description: A presence moves toward the Sanctuary. Farris moves faster. He destroys what approaches, at cost to himself.

3.title: Collapse or Transcendence
3.tagline:
Everything comes to a head.
Some threads hold. Some burn.

events.name: The First Warning Returns
events.description: Yuul grabs Maeve's wrist-eyes glassy, speech inverted. A second warning, more frantic than the first.

events.name: Rielle Sees It Too
events.description: Rielle corners Maeve. Sharp, honest, cutting. 'You keep leaving. Kit's drowning. She's getting worse.'

events.name: The Photo Album
events.description: Kit brings old photos. Yuul returns fully for one fragile night. He memorizes her.

events.name: Daniel Calls the DCE
events.description: Daniel thinks he's helping. He calls the Directorate. They send three agents for Yuul.

events.name: The List Theory (Maeve's Obsession Solidifies)
events.description: Maeve becomes convinced The List hunts Yuul and can be fought. Her obsession crystallizes.

events.name: The Seeress Speaks
events.description: Yuul's eyes go blank. The Seeress looks out: 'You can never leave this place.'

events.name: Rielle Burns Redchurch
events.description: Rielle acts alone. Burns the wound-site. Yuul screams across distance.

events.name: Kit Breaks
events.description: Kit finally snaps. 'Do something. Please.' His breaking loads the gun the next card will fire.

events.name: The Mirror - Yuul's Ascension/Dissolution
events.description: Yuul stands before the Mirror. The Seeress dances. Yuul mirrors her. She becomes.

events.name: The List Manifests
events.description: The entity that eats names descends. High coherence and low coherence both become prey.

events.name: Kit Confesses His Love
events.description: Kit finally speaks: 'It's always been you.' Yuul remembers being a person.

events.name: Maeve's True Obsession - The Insight That Saves Them
events.description: Maeve realizes The List feeds on both extremes-dissolution AND ascension. She sees the real danger.

events.name: Redchurch Prelude
events.description: The moment before everything changes. The air tastes metallic.

events.name: The Kettle Blackout
events.description: Daniel makes the call. Does Maeve lie to protect them or tell the truth?

events.name: The Dream Bleeds Through
events.description: Images repeat. Edges double. Echo overlaps begin.

events.name: Coherence Whiplash
events.description: High coherence collapses slightly; low coherence rises. The field snaps toward the deadly middle.

events.name: DCE Restraint Order
events.description: Daniel decides: defect to save them, or authorize the raid.

events.name: The Choirbreak Moment
events.description: A fracture in sound. Everyone loses coherence except Maeve (if she holds the True Insight).

events.name: The Thread Cuts
events.description: A Sacred dyad shatters. Pressure drops. Chaos rises.

events.name: The Name Eater Stirs
events.description: High coherence names begin to glow-marked as prey.

events.name: The House That Hears
events.description: The walls echo wrong. A pattern repeats. Something is listening.

events.name: The Radio Bleeds
events.description: Static resolves into voices. DCE frequencies. They're triangulating.

events.name: Farris Refuses to Let Maeve Go Alone
events.description: Farris blocks the door. 'If you're walking into it, I'm coming too.'

events.name: Wolf-Sense: The Door Is Already Open
events.description: Farris can feel it: something at Redchurch opened itself. 'The door is already open.'

events.name: Daniel Makes the Call
events.description: Daniel calls H11 again. They send a strategist, not a counselor.

events.name: Daniel's Last Warning
events.description: Daniel begs Maeve to stop. Fear in his voice she's never heard.

events.name: The Field Bows to Her
events.description: Maeve steps into the wound in the field and stitches it shut with sheer force of will. A psychic lighthouse flickers into being.

events.name: He Refuses to Give Up
events.description: Someone is seconds from dissolving. Kit anchors them with desperate tenderness, dragging them back from the brink.

events.name: She Breaks the Pattern
events.description: Rielle sees the resonance knot trapping them and cuts it with furious, impossible clarity.

events.name: Protocol Null: He Chooses Them
events.description: Daniel breaks protocol and sabotages a Directorate operation. For one moment, he is theirs.

events.name: He Holds the Line Alone
events.description: A monstrous presence tears through the field. Farris stands alone, and reality bends around his defiance.

events.name: She Remembers Herself Completely
events.description: For one impossible moment, Yuul is whole—prophet and human, bound and free. She hands them a vision of the perfect path.

witness.text: Memorize them exactly as they are. Every voice. Every light. Every fragile peace.

trickster.text: Turn the warmth into joy-tease, poke, spark shared laughter until the night feels endless.

devourer.text: Give your calm away. Let the one most wounded borrow your steadiness for this one soft hour.

witness.text: Meet their eyes. Let them know you see what they see.

trickster.text: Break the moment with mischief-bend attention away before truth lands.

devourer.text: Absorb the scrutiny. Take the stranger's unease into yourself so the others don't flinch.

witness.text: Tell her you saw it. Name the shift she tried to hide.

trickster.text: Break the tension-make a joke sharp enough to snap her back into the moment.

devourer.text: Take the fear from her expression and carry it in your bones instead.

witness.text: You answer plainly. No hedging. The truth lands harder than a lie.

trickster.text: Redirect, reframe, let them chase a shadow instead.

devourer.text: You take blame subtly-just enough to shield the others.

witness.text: You map every observation point. 'They're not hiding anymore.'

trickster.text: You create false signals-errands, diversions, misdirections.

devourer.text: You step forward as the likely anomaly. Let the net catch you first.

witness.text: You take inventory of the breach with brutal clarity.

trickster.text: You erase traces, rewrite scenes, seed the room with alternative stories.

devourer.text: You step into the breach and accept the consequences personally.

witness.text: You speak plainly about instability inside the house.

trickster.text: You make the whisper network chase its own tail.

devourer.text: You let suspicion fall toward you. Better you than them.

witness.text: You read the order aloud. Naming corruption is its own power.

trickster.text: You obey selectively, bending the order into something survivable.

devourer.text: You take the order into yourself-like swallowing a blade meant for the others.

witness.text: 'Stay with me. Say it out loud.' You pull her gently back into the room.

trickster.text: You interrupt the spiral with a joke sharp enough to cut the atmosphere.

devourer.text: You take the weight of her vision into your own chest. 'Let me carry that.'

witness.text: 'Don't look away.' You meet your own impossible reflection.

trickster.text: You distort the moment-shift posture, blink deliberately-as if negotiating with the mirror.

devourer.text: You press a hand to the glass and accept the fracture into yourself.

witness.text: 'Let it finish.' You hold the world still around her.

trickster.text: You bend the phrasing-turn a doom into a door.

devourer.text: You take the prophecy into your own resonance. It hooks into your ribs.

witness.text: Stand. Do not tremble. The storm knows your name, but you are older than the wind.

trickster.text: Oh sweetheart, don't brace-lean. Let the world slip sideways with you.

devourer.text: Give it to me. All of it. I will take the first blow and the second and the third until nothing touches you but my teeth.

witness.text: Call her by the name she buried. Names remember when flesh forgets.

trickster.text: If she's falling through the cracks, darling-fall faster and grab her on the way down.

devourer.text: Let me. I can drag her back from the dark by the wrist; she will come screaming but alive.

witness.text: A soft lie is sometimes a scaffold. Build it gently.

trickster.text: Oh my god yes, lie. Lie beautifully. Lie like it's a performance art piece.

devourer.text: Let him choke on your silence. I'll cover your tracks.

witness.text: Love is a compass even in the fire. Let him name the star he follows.

trickster.text: Oh this is going to hurt deliciously. Open the curtain.

devourer.text: Let him bare his throat. I want to see who answers.

witness.text: Say it aloud. The world reshapes around spoken truth.

trickster.text: Hell yes declare it, Queen. Break the tutorial.

devourer.text: Claim the knowledge. Let the List hear you. Let it turn toward you.

witness.text: Step sideways. Rhythm obeys you.

trickster.text: Kick the wall. Kick fate. Kick something.

devourer.text: Tear the pattern until it screams.

witness.text: Cut the cord. End the message.

trickster.text: Unplug it with flair. Kick it across the room.

devourer.text: Silence it. I hunger for the quiet.

witness.text: Anchor her. You once promised not to leave.

trickster.text: Shake her until the world resets.

devourer.text: Give her something stronger to cling to: you.

witness.text: Hold his hand. Turn him gently.

trickster.text: Trip him. Literally.

devourer.text: Say his name like a command. Make him obey.

witness.text: Stand in the light of your name.

trickster.text: Ohhh let's see how badly this ends.

devourer.text: Stay. I want to see who survives you.
